assistant/write.batchTitle: Run {count, plural, one {# write} other {# writes}} in one transaction?
assistant/write.allOrNone: Either all of them are written or none.
assistant/write.permanentDeletes: {count, plural, one {# delete cannot} other {# deletes cannot}} be undone: those records are removed for good.
assistant/write.moreWrites: And {count} more {count, plural, one {write} other {writes}}, not listed.

better-auth/connections.CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND: You have no connected account with this id.
better-auth/connections.FAILED_TO_UNLINK_LAST_ACCOUNT: This is your only way to sign in: add another before you disconnect it.
better-auth/connections.CONNECTIONS_STARTING: Connections are starting: try again in a moment.
better-auth/connections.CONNECTION_NOT_SIGN_IN: This provider connects an account to a workflow; it does not sign in.
better-auth/connections.CONNECTION_UNLINK_REFUSED: This account is connected to workflows: disconnect it under Connections.

workflows/connections.ownSignInOnly: Only the owner of each connection this workflow uses, signed in as themselves, can turn it on: turn it off to save it, and its owner turns it on again in the admin app
workflows/connections.unbound: Connect an account for {connections} in the workflow's connections before turning it on
workflows/connections.notConnected: This workflow has no connection it may use for {key}: its owner connects an account and turns the workflow on
workflows/connections.linkExpired: The account connected for {key} no longer signs in: its owner connects it again
workflows/connections.undeclared: {step} signs in through "{name}", which this app does not declare
workflows/connections.stopNotConnected: This trigger has no connection it may end its subscription with for {key}: the account it was made with is no longer connected
workflows/connections.stopLinkExpired: The account connected for {key} no longer signs in, so this trigger cannot end its subscription with it
workflows/connections.disconnected: The connected account was disconnected: its owner connects it again
workflows/connections.subscriptionNotEnded: The subscription could not be ended at the provider: {reason}
